Staff Engineer, Distributed Systems
Meridian Ledger

FICTIONAL job post for tests.

Meridian Ledger runs a double-entry ledger as a service for fintech companies. We process 40 million entries a day with strict consistency guarantees.

As a Staff Engineer you will set technical direction for our core ledger team of eight. You will design for correctness first: idempotency, exactly-once processing, and consistent reads across regions.

Responsibilities
- Lead the design of our next-generation ledger storage on PostgreSQL with logical replication.
- Own cross-team technical decisions and write the design documents behind them.
- Build critical services in Go and some performance-sensitive parts in Rust.
- Design gRPC APIs used by 120 customer integrations.
- Mentor senior engineers and raise the bar on code review.

Requirements
- 8+ years of software engineering, including 3+ years at staff or principal level.
- Deep experience with distributed systems and consensus (Raft or Paxos).
- Production Go; Rust is a strong plus.
- PostgreSQL internals.
- Experience with financial ledgers or payments.

Nice to have
- Kafka.
- Formal methods (TLA+).

$150,000 to $190,000 a year. Remote worldwide.
